content.short: RealT is a real estate tokenization platform that enables fractional ownership of US properties on-chain for all.
content.description: RealT is a pioneering decentralized platform designed to democratize access to the real estate market by tokenizing US-based properties on the Ethereum and Gnosis blockchains. The protocol allows investors worldwide to purchase RealTokens, representing fractional ownership in specific residential or commercial assets. This approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for property investment, enabling participants to build a diversified portfolio. Investors in RealT properties receive a share of the rental income, which is paid out weekly in stablecoins to their digital wallets.
content.meta: RealT provides fractional real estate tokenization and stablecoin rental yields. Discover RealT and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer platform.
